raw.details:
FUTUREX 2026 – Innovating for Global Challenges

What if your idea could help solve a real-world problem and contribute to a better future?

Skill2Career, Ed-Tech platform presents FutureX 2026, an innovation-driven Ideathon that brings together students to identify global challenges, think beyond conventional solutions, and propose innovative ideas that create meaningful impact.

Aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs), FutureX encourages participants to explore challenges across technology, sustainability, agriculture, healthcare, accessibility, employment, and community development.

This Ideathon provides a platform for students to showcase their creativity, critical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and innovative perspectives by transforming real-world challenges into practical and impactful project ideas.

Project Themes:

Participants can choose any ONE of the following themes:

  1. Sustainable Urban Living & Smart Infrastructure
  2. AI-Driven Solutions for Social Challenges
  3. Smart Agriculture & Food Security
  4. Water Conservation & Resource Management
  5. Inclusive Technology & Digital Accessibility
  6. Women's Empowerment & Community Safety
  7. Future of Employment & Digital Entrepreneurship
  8. Rural Innovation & Digital Transformation
  9. Waste-to-Wealth & Resource Innovation
  10. Smart Food Systems & Zero-Waste Communities

What Participants Can Expect:

  • An opportunity to identify and address real-world challenges.
  •  A platform to showcase innovative thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills.
  •  Winner, Runner-up, and Second Runner-up certificates for outstanding teams.
  • Internship opportunities for the Top 3 teams, along with additional internship opportunities for other outstanding teams demonstrating exceptional performance.
  •  Participation certificates for participants.
  •  Appreciation certificates to recognize noteworthy contributions and efforts.

Who Can Participate?

Students interested in innovation, technology, entrepreneurship, sustainability, and solving real-world challenges are encouraged to participate.

Why FutureX?

Every great innovation begins with an idea. FutureX aims to encourage students to think differently, challenge existing approaches, and develop ideas that can contribute to a more sustainable, inclusive, and innovative world.

Think Beyond. Innovate Today. Shape Tomorrow.

Organized by Skill2Career Ed-Tech,

ACQUIRE SKILLS. BUILD CAREERS.
